answer: Exploit what one owner behind many masks cannot hide: it pockets both sides of every deal. Each epoch, random seat pairs play a small sealed steal-or-share round where stealing pays the stealer 1 coin but costs the partner 2. Independent agents steal at some steady rate; an operator facing its own puppet loses a coin net by stealing, so it shares. Over many pairings, a grove of seats that spare each other while robbing strangers stands out like a glacier on the horizon and is merged into one reward share. Faking theft against siblings burns real coin.
